title: IndoNutriQA: An Indonesian Clinical Nutrition Question Answering Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.31256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical Question Answering (QA) underpins Clinical Intelligent Decision Support Systems, but progress is severely limited for low-resource languages such as Indonesian by the absence of public domain-specific data. We introduce IndoNutriQA, an expert-curated Indonesian clinical QA benchmark of 911 question-answer pairs built from real clinical-nutrition reports. Rather than a large-scale training corpus, it is positioned as a high-quality evaluation resource: every pair is grounded in a clinically relevant context, enriched with structured metadata (anthropometric assessment, medical diagnosis, document provenance, chunk segmentation). Eight standardised question types following the Nutrition Care Process (NCP), including the Problem, Etiology, Sign and Symptom (PES) diagnosis statement, are answered for every report, which was written by a graduate-level dietetic intern, by one of three nutritionists. translated_title: IndoNutriQA：一个印度尼西亚临床营养问答基准
translated_abstract: 临床问答是临床智能决策支持系统的基础，但对于印度尼西亚语等低资源语言而言，由于缺乏公开的领域专用数据，其进展受到严重限制。我们提出了IndoNutriQA，这是一个由专家精心构建的印度尼西亚临床问答基准，包含911个基于真实临床营养报告构建的问答对。它并非大规模训练语料库，而是定位为高质量评估资源：每个问答对都以临床相关上下文为基础，并辅以结构化元数据（人体测量评估、医学诊断、文档来源、分块分割）。每份报告由研究生水平的营养学实习生撰写，并由三名营养师之一按照营养护理流程（NCP）回答八种标准化问题类型，其中包括“问题、病因、体征和症状”（PES）诊断陈述。答案为自由格式的临床专业文本。
tldr: 该论文提出了IndoNutriQA——首个由专家构建的印度尼西亚临床营养问答基准，包含基于真实临床营养报告的911个高质量问答对及结构化元数据，旨在填补低资源语言在临床问答评估资源上的空白。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces IndoNutriQA, the first expert-curated Indonesian clinical nutrition QA benchmark with 911 high-quality question-answer pairs grounded in real clinical nutrition reports, filling the gap of evaluation resources for clinical QA in low-resource languages.
